study_identification_part.si_4_title: Molecular and micro-architectural mapping of gray matter alterations in psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABCD, ASRB, CNP (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics LA5c), MCIC, and UK Biobank are explicitly named; B-SNIP, PAFIP, and ALSPAC are not in the controlled vocabulary so recorded as Unknown.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "MRI from individuals with chronic schizophrenia (SCZ; n = 525; age = 37.63 ± 12.06) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD; n = 62; age = 33.77 ± 10.78), clustered under SCZ and SAD-chronic group, were obtained from Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) ... Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) ... Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes (B-SNIP) ... UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) LA5c Study ... Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery (MIND) Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC) ... and UK Biobank (UKB)"; "MRI data from individuals who were determined to have experienced a first episode of psychosis (FEP; n = 352; age = 31.43 ± 8.78), along with their respective HC ... were obtained from Programa de Atención a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP)"; "All these individuals were sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) birth cohort"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, L39-L43

answer.ABCD: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients and healthy controls

answer.ASRB: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients and healthy controls

answer.B-SNIP: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients; SCZ/SAD first-degree relatives; healthy controls shared with chronic group

answer.CNP LA5c: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients and healthy controls

answer.MCIC: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients and healthy controls

answer.UK Biobank: chronic SCZ/SAD group patients and healthy controls

answer.PAFIP: first episode of psychosis patients and matched healthy controls

answer.ALSPAC: psychotic experience subclinical groups and cohort controls

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Datasets were used to supply MRI data for chronic SCZ/SAD patients and HCs, FEP patients with their HCs, psychotic-experience subclinical groups with cohort controls, and SCZ/SAD relatives with HCs.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "MRI from individuals with chronic schizophrenia (SCZ; n = 525; age = 37.63 ± 12.06) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD; n = 62; age = 33.77 ± 10.78), clustered under SCZ and SAD-chronic group, were obtained from Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) ... Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) ... Bipolar-Schizophrenia Network on Intermediate Phenotypes (B-SNIP) ... UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP) LA5c Study ... Mental Illness and Neuroscience Discovery (MIND) Institute Clinical Imaging Consortium (MCIC) ... and UK Biobank (UKB)"; "Healthy controls (n = 38,232; age = 51.91 ± 23.68) comprised individuals from previous datasets"; "MRI data from individuals who were determined to have experienced a first episode of psychosis (FEP; n = 352; age = 31.43 ± 8.78), along with their respective HC (n = 195; age = 30.64 ± 7.66), were obtained from Programa de Atención a las Fases Iniciales de Psicosis (PAFIP)"; "All these individuals were sourced from Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) birth cohort"; "MRI data from first-degree relatives of schizophrenia (SCZ-relatives; n = 96; age = 43.75 ± 15.25) and schizoaffective disorder (SAD-relatives; n = 64; age = 40.00 ± 16.20), clustered under SCZ and SAD-relatives group; were obtained from B-SNIP. The HC group consisted of the same individuals as the chronic group."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: GarciaSanMartin2025.pdf.md: Subjects and Methods / Subjects, L39-L45

model-1.model-name: Lifespan Brain Chart GAMLSS normative model (Bethlehem et al. 2022)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative centiles were derived from the pre-trained Brain Chart model built on ~100 studies (~120,000 participants); training split not reported in this paper.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "This model ... estimated cross-sectional normative age-related trends from 100 different studies (around 120,000 participants; see Supplementary Information in [20] for details of the normative cohort, pages 120-151)."
